verdict.rationale: Only thin evidence applies: a marketing tagline promising team collaboration (unity-docs-2), and Build Automation documented as supporting most popular version control systems (unity-docs-36). Nothing in the pack covers how the project format itself behaves under version control. Missing for 10: documentation of text-serialized (diffable) scene/asset formats, scene/prefab merge tooling, a concrete built-in collaboration or version-control product, and independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-person workflows.
